beaches.name: Psili Ammos (Aigiali)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across this small pebble beach near Aigiali. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 to 2023, ranging from 10% to 100% nude; a tourism directory says nudism is unofficially practised here. It sits on a hiking trail, so clothed walkers pass regularly.

beaches.name: Kambi
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual at this rocky cove south of Agia Anna. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2003 to 2022, ranging from 60% to 100% naturist; a tourism directory names Kambi for nudism. Access is a scramble along the rocks from Agia Anna beach, which itself is reported mostly textile.

beaches.name: Mouros
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the small coves beyond the rocks east of the main beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2006 to 2021; the side coves were fully nude in 2013 and 2021, while the main beach below the taverna is swimwear. The directory calls it a historical nudist beach that changed after road access arrived in 2006.
